50723409.baseName: Humbrol No.1 Matt Grey Primer Enamel Paint - 14ml Tin for Model Kits, Miniatures & Craft Projects
50723409.variantName: Humbrol No.1 Matt Grey Primer Enamel Paint - 14ml Tin for Model Kits, Miniatures & Craft Projects
50723409.sourceDescription:
Prepare your models and miniatures for a flawless finish with Humbrol No.1 Matt Grey Primer Enamel Paint (14ml). This essential primer delivers smooth, even coverage, ensuring that topcoat colours adhere perfectly for professional-looking results.

Product Overview
Ideal for hobbyists and model enthusiasts, this primer creates a reliable base layer for paints, preventing uneven absorption and enhancing durability. Suitable for plastic, wood, and metal surfaces, it's perfect for model kits, miniatures, and a wide range of craft projects.

Key Features

– Even Surface Prep: Provides a uniform base for topcoat paints.
– Matt Finish: Ensures smooth paint application with no glossy spots.
– Versatile Use: Works on plastic, metal, wood, and other common model materials.
– Compact 14ml Tin: Perfect for small-scale detailing and precision work.
– Trusted Brand: Humbrol is a leading name in model paints with decades of expertise.


Specifications

– Brand: Humbrol
– Colour: Grey Primer (No.1)
– Paint Type: Enamel
– Finish: Matt
– Volume: 14ml
– Application: Brush or airbrush (thin before spraying)
– Suitable Surfaces: Plastic, metal, wood


Ideal For

– Model kits and scale models
– Miniatures and tabletop gaming figures
– Model railway scenery and locomotives
– DIY craft projects and custom painting


How to Use
Stir the paint thoroughly before use. Apply in thin, even coats using a brush or airbrush. Allow to dry completely before applying enamel or acrylic topcoats. For airbrushing, thin the primer with Humbrol Enamel Thinners.

Why Choose Humbrol?
Humbrol has been trusted by modelers worldwide for decades, delivering high-quality paints and primers designed to achieve professional, long-lasting results on every project.

Lightweight Design

Reusable Design
The reusable format is intended to be used again after suitable care. Keep it clean and store it between uses so it remains ready for the next occasion.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show

Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

5056533502509.variantName: Artificial Christmas Tree 7ft Easy Assembly Foldable 1200 Tips Tree with Strong Stand
5056533502509.sourceDescription:
Bring festive cheer and timeless elegance into your home this holiday season with our 7ft Artificial Christmas Tree, designed to capture the magic of Christmas without the mess and maintenance of a real tree. Standing tall at 7 feet, this tree offers an impressive centerpiece for your seasonal décor, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere for family gatherings, holiday parties, or office celebrations.

Crafted with hundreds of individually crafted branch tips, the tree achieves a full and realistic appearance, providing ample space for ornaments, garlands, and lights. The lush green PVC needles mimic the look of fresh pine, offering the beauty of nature with durability and long-lasting quality. The hinged branch design makes assembly and disassembly quick and easy, allowing you to spend less time setting up and more time enjoying the festivities.

Supported by a strong, stable metal stand, this tree ensures stability and balance even when adorned with decorations. Christmas Baubles
Add colour and detail to your Christmas tree with these decorative baubles. Their hanging format lets you spread the ornaments through the branches or combine them with other suitable festive displays for a coordinated seasonal arrangement.

Shatter Resistant Design
The ornaments use a shatter resistant construction for the stated decorative use. They provide an alternative to traditional glass decorations when arranging the display, while retaining a defined shape and finish for the festive setting.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Material: Plastic. Colour: Green. Quantity: 12 piece set.
Shatter resistant plastic construction provides safe, durable festive decoration.
Includes a complete set of 12 green baubles for coordinated tree styling.
Hanging format allows easy placement throughout branches or display arrangements.
Plastic material offers a lightweight alternative to traditional glass ornaments.

6313817039809.baseName: 6 Sheets Christmas Static Window Clings, Santa Claus Reindeer Snowflake Window Decals, Double Sided Print Static Stickers
6313817039809.variantName: 6 Sheets Christmas Static Window Clings, Santa Claus Reindeer Snowflake Window Decals, Double Sided Print Static Stickers
6313817039809.sourceDescription:
Product Features:

 The set includes 6 Christmas static window stickers: 1 Santa Claus style, 1 Reindeer style, 4 2008 snowflake styles, each with a size of 20×29cm (7.87×11.42 inches), double-sided printed, with consistent pattern effect on both sides of the glass.
 They are made of static PVC material, do not require glue, and adhere to the smooth glass through static electricity. They can be removed without leaving any residue, and will not scratch or damage the glass surface.
 Installation is simple and they can be reused. After cleaning the glass, spray a little water and it can be stuck. They can be adjusted to different positions multiple times, stored and saved, and can be used again during the Christmas season next
 year.
 Rich Christmas elements: Santa Claus, Reindeer, various snowflake shapes, vivid patterns, creating a strong festive atmosphere. Suitable for decoration of windows and glass doors in families, shops, and classrooms.


Product Specifications:

 Quantity: 6 pieces
 Color: White
 Size: 20*29 cm
 Material: PVC


Packaging Contents:
Waterproof wall sticker * 6

Note:

 This product is only applicable to smooth, clean and flat glass surfaces. It cannot adhere to frosted glass, textured walls, wooden surfaces, or rough and uneven surfaces.
 Before sticking, make sure to clean the glass thoroughly, remove dust and oil stains, and a small amount of water mist on the surface is more conducive to the secure adhesion of the electrostatic adhesive.
 After use, roll it up and store it in a cool and dry place for storage. Do not forcefully fold or press it, avoid prolonged exposure to strong sunlight, and prevent the pattern from fading.
Package includes 6 sheets Christmas static window clings: 1 sheet Santa Claus style, 1 sheet Reindeer style, 4sheets snowflake style. Each sheet measures 20×29cm (7.87×11.42 inches). Adopted double-sided printing craft, the patterns show the same effect on both sides of glass.
Made of premium static PVC material, no adhesive needed. These window decals rely on static electricity to attach smoothly on smooth glass surfaces. They can be peeled off easily without leaving sticky residues, no damage to your window glass.
Easy to apply and reposition. Just clean the glass surface, spray a little water, then stick the static clings and squeeze out bubbles. You can reposition and reuse them many times, perfect for repeated holiday decoration every year.
Cute Christmas elements including Santa, reindeer and various snowflakes. Vivid festive patterns create strong Christmas atmosphere. Great decoration for shop windows, home glass doors, classroom windows, restaurant glass for holiday party decor.
Safe and lightweight PVC material, non-toxic and odorless. The cut lines are neat, you can tear out individual patterns freely to DIY your window layout. Ideal Christmas gift for family, kids, teachers and friends for holiday decor.

Merry Christmas! How can you decorate your home this winter and make Christmas unforgettable and fun?

Reusable Christmas window stickers are a must for Christmas decoration, whether at home or in the shop. Let our winter snowflake Christmas decoration take you into the magical world of the holidays - prepare yourself now for an unforgettable Christmas
 season full of harmony and cosiness.

Special feature:

Double Side Printed
These Christmas window clings feature a double-sided pattern, allowing you to enjoy beautiful designs from both inside and outside the window.

Cute Christmas Patterns
With a large quantity of xmas window clings, you can easily create your own festive winter wonderland.

Bright Colorful
Crafted from PVC materials, these Christmas stickers adhere securely to windows and smooth surfaces with water.

Different Size
Our window decals come in various sizes, making them easy to apply to windows, glass, refrigerators, and any smooth surface.

Specifications:

Material: PVC, electrostatic film.

Size: 30 x 20 cm.

Packing list:

9 x static winter snowflakes window stickers Christmas.

Note:

1. Make sure to clean the surface before applying the static adhesive PVC sticker. Spray a little water before sticking to make the window picture firmer.

2. These snowflake Christmas decorations are suitable for most smooth surfaces, but are not recommended for rough surfaces.
Packing Includes: This Christmas decorations set features 9 sheets of Christmas window clings for glass, including 1 sheet each of Santa Claus, elf, snowman, tree, and snow designs—totaling 188 pieces. Each sheet measures 7.87" x 11.81".
High-Quality Christmas Window Stickers: Made from high quality PVC materials, these Xmas decals adhere to windows or other smooth surfaces with water, staying in place for a long time without easily falling off.
Double-Sided Snowflake Window Clings: Designed with double-sided patterns, these xmas clings are visible from both indoors and outdoors, ensuring a festive look no matter where you are.
Easy to Apply and Remove: These Christmas decor require no adhesive—simply clean the surface, apply with water, and enjoy. They can be removed effortlessly without leaving any residue behind.
Perfect Holiday Decorations: With a variety of festive designs, these Christmas decorations are suitable for creating a joyful atmosphere and making your Christmas party unforgettable.

5096825900309.sourceDescription:
Christmas Elf Decoration
Adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. Key details include self adhesive.

Self Adhesive
The self adhesive backing provides a direct way to attach the item to a compatible surface. Prepare the surface and align the position before pressing it into place.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product details

Pack of 500 self-adhesive Christmas elf decorations for festive home styling.
Compact 50x50 mm size allows precise placement and detailed arrangement.
Self-adhesive backing provides a direct, tool-free attachment method.
Designed specifically to add a festive detail to your Christmas display.

5056797098909.sourceDescription:
Add movement and sparkle to your festive decor with this 60cm meteor windmill light from MySmartBuy. Its hanging windmill design is lit with 144 warm white LEDs with 15 lighting effects, including a falling meteor effect. Hang it in a window, on a wall or as a party feature. It is supplied with a 5m lead cable and IP20 transformer, giving plenty of reach from your socket, and the built-in timer lights it for 6 hours and then switches it off for 18 hours, so it comes on at the same time every evening without you needing to remember. Festive lights are a simple way to bring warmth and atmosphere to dark winter evenings. Group them with candles, greenery and decorations, place them where they can be seen from outside, or use them to create a cosy corner for the family to enjoy throughout December. A simple, stylish way to bring festive sparkle into your home, and a lovely finishing touch for Christmas displays and parties. At a glance: 60cm hanging meteor windmill | 144 warm white LEDs | 5m lead cable | IP20 transformer | 6 hours on / 18 hours off timer | indoor use.
60CM METEOR WINDMILL : 144 warm white LEDs in a hanging windmill design.
HANGING DESIGN : Perfect for windows and walls.
5M LEAD CABLE : Supplied with a 5m lead cable and IP20 transformer, giving plenty of reach from your socket to your chosen spot.
AUTOMATIC TIMER : Built-in 6 hours on / 18 hours off timer, so it lights up at the same time every evening without you having to remember.
INDOOR DECORATION : Windows, walls, living rooms and parties.

Complete your Christmas tree with a warm, tidy finish beneath the branches. This red square Christmas tree skirt is designed to hide the exposed stand, helping the whole display look cleaner, more coordinated and ready for presents.

Unlike a flat tree skirt, this raised Christmas tree stand cover creates a defined shape around the base. The cosy red material adds a traditional festive touch, while the square form helps reduce the unfinished look of visible legs or supports.

Christmas Wreath
This Christmas wreath adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The red finish and plastic and fabric construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product details
Material: Plastic and Fabric. Colour: Red. Product measurements: length 15 cm, width 15 cm, height 4 cm. Product weight: 0.16 kg. Quantity: 1 piece.

Compact design measuring 15 cm in length and width, ideal for creating a focal point on doors or walls.

Easy to position and store, allowing flexible placement within your coordinated holiday decor scheme.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Compact Format
The compact format helps the item fit into a smaller working or storage area. It is useful where you want the function close to hand without filling the whole space.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show

Add a magical finishing touch to your tree with this Gold Star Topper. Its rotating design projects sparkling snowflake patterns across your ceiling, bringing dynamic, festive light to any room. Fully remote-controlled with adjustable speed, brightness and flash settings — the statement piece that takes your tree from decorated to spectacular.

What's included
1 x Gold Star Topper (with attached power cable and mounting clip)
1 x Remote control

How to use
Open the clip and attach the star to the highest, most stable point of your tree — avoid weak branches
Plug the adapter into the mains
Use the remote to turn on/off, pause rotation, select flash mode, adjust brightness/speed, and set the auto-off timer

Good to know
Sent by courier with free standard UK delivery
Returns accepted within 30 days
Covered by a 1-year manufacturer warranty

FAQs
Does the star rotate?
Yes — 3 adjustable speed levels, controlled via the included remote.

How is it powered?
The star is mains-powered via the attached UK plug adapter. The remote runs on a button cell battery (not included).

Can I set it to turn off automatically?
Yes. The remote's timer switches it off after 2, 4, 6, or 8 hours.

How do I attach it to my tree?
Open the clip and fix it to the highest, most stable point on your tree. Avoid weak or thin branches.

Is it suitable for outdoor use?
Designed for indoor use only. Display in a dry, sheltered location.

Is it covered by a warranty?
Yes, with a 1-year manufacturer warranty.

How is it delivered?
Sent by courier with free standard UK delivery.

Safety Information
For indoor use only. Do not use if damaged or wet. Unplug by the plug, not the cord. Keep cords, batteries and small parts away from children/pets. Button cell battery (not included) can cause serious injury if swallowed — seek immediate medical attention. Keep compartment closed.

5059442001309.sourceDescription:
The original Christmas tree, the Norway Spruce has been grown in the UK since Victorian times and is the variety most people picture at Christmas. Its classic conical shape, dark green foliage and fresh scent bring a traditional, nostalgic feel to your home, and its firm, slightly prickly needles are ideal for hanging decorations. Norway Spruce can drop needles if it dries out, so keeping it well watered is key. Our trees are grown in the UK and freshly cut before dispatch. When your tree arrives, cut a few centimetres from the base of the trunk and stand it in water straight away. Keep it in a stand with a water reservoir, topped up every 1-2 days, and away from radiators and fires so it stays fresh throughout Christmas.
REAL FRESH CUT TREE - Add a traditional feel to your home this Christmas with a freshly cut, real Norway Spruce
PREMIUM QUALITY, FRESH FROM THE FARM - Our Christmas trees are grown in the UK, ensuring the highest growing standards, and cared for year round by our expert team
TRADITIONAL LOOK AND FEEL - The classic Christmas tree look, with dark green foliage and firm, slightly prickly needles that are ideal for hanging decorations
STAND SOLD SEPARATELY - A stand with a water reservoir is vital for keeping your tree fresh. Pop your tree in, fill it with water and you're ready to decorate
CARE GUIDE SUPPLIED WITH EVERY TREE - Keep your tree in top condition with our free step-by-step care guide. This gives tips on prepping, watering and decorating your tree.
